message: Spotless studio and only a short walk to Central. Check-in was easy and Sam replied to every message within minutes.
Waking up to the ocean view was amazing. Five minutes to the beach and plenty of cafes nearby.
Bright room in a lovely old terrace and the shared kitchen was always clean. A bit of street noise on Friday night.
Great location and a comfortable bed. Street parking was hard to find on the weekend.
Perfect for our family weekend. The kids loved the pool and the kitchen had everything we needed.
Compact but really well designed. Fast Wi-Fi made it easy to work from the studio.
Such a charming cottage. The garden is beautiful and it felt like home from the moment we arrived.
Modern apartment with a great view of the city lights. Close to the station and the shopping centre.
Spacious, on a quiet street and with a big backyard. Priya left a lovely welcome basket.
Lots of natural light and a nice balcony for morning coffee. Would stay again.
Plenty of space for the three of us and a short walk to Westfield and the train.
Second time staying here and it was just as good. Olivia's local tips were spot on.
